test_title: PYST 8:SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On:17 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice. **

The audience loved her performance.

options.text: The audience will love her performance.
The performance is loved by the audience.
Her performance was loved by the audience.
The performance was loved by her.

solution:
The correct passive voice is: **Her performance was loved by the audience.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in active voice, with the subject "**audience**" performing the action of "**loving**" the object "**her performance**."
 
• To convert to passive voice, we need to make the object the subject and the subject the object.
 
• "**Her performance**" becomes the subject, "**was loved**" becomes the verb in passive voice, and "**by the audience**" remains the object.
 
• The sentence now emphasizes the action being done to the subject, rather than the subject performing the action.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**The audience will love her performance**" changes the tense and keeps the sentence in an active voice.
 
• "**The performance is loved by the audience**" only partially converts to passive voice by making the object the subject, but keeps the verb in active voice.
 
• "**The performance was loved by her**" changes the object to the subject, but creates a nonsensical sentence by making "her" the object of "loved."
